episode_summary: In this episode, Bill Melnik shares his journey from a corporate career at Ralph Lauren to becoming a top luxury real estate agent. He discusses the importance of staging, leveraging past experiences, and using social media to build a personal brand. Bill also offers insights into handling pricing conversations with sellers and the limitations of AI in understanding local market nuances.
